data.name: Guitar Chords finger positions
data.abstract: Position of the fingers for 2633 guitar chords in standard tuning (double checked with software)

additional_info.summary: For each row, the dataset provides: the root of the chord, the type of chord, the intervals that compose the chord, and the finger positions.
additional_info.variable_info:
The finger positions are denoted for each guitar string (from the lowest E to the highest).
x: string muted, 0: open string, 1: index finger, 2: middle finger, 3: ring finger, 4: pinkie
